verdict.rationale: EDD's own file-and-pay guidance lists Federal/State Employment Taxes (FSET) and Electronic Funds Transfer channels (State Data Collector, ACH Credit) alongside the human e-Services portal. These are machine-oriented filing and payment rails, but the evidence is only a bare listing. The third-party representative enrollment covers people (tax preparers, accountants) using the web portal, not software, and the probes found no published API spec. missing for 10: a documented description of FSET/EFT as system-to-system channels, a published enrollment path for transmitters or batch providers, system or service account provisioning, technical specifications, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: Federal/State Employment Taxes (FSET); Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT): State Data Collector, Automated Clearing House (ACH) Credit
